name: kitsune-workspace
description: Kitsune: let AI agents (Claude, via MCP) drive your real Firefox.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && npm --prefix host run build
scripts.lint: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/store && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/full
scripts.test:all: node test/e2e.mjs && KITSUNE_E2E_TRUSTED=1 node test/e2e.mjs && node test/e2e-safety.mjs && node test/e2e-permissions.mjs && node test/e2e-store.mjs && node test/e2e-resilience.mjs
